description: A rapid piece full of alternating strings and bassoons, with long and drastic bass notes. The heavy funereal chimes and foreboding minor key evoke a scene of a frantic chase through the woods or a race against time.
instruments: Strings, Chimes, Glockenspiel, Bassoon, Bass Clarinet
title: Constancy Part One
